title: Bare Bones x The Roads More Travelled (TRMT)
description: Simplifies the eroded path textures to fit Bare Bones
body:
This pack simplifies the textures of The Roads More travelled to fit in with Bare Bones.

Most importantly, the grass lines stay in the same direction even with the randomised path textures.
